title: Degree truncation
statement: For $k\in\mathbb{N}$ and a function $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb{R}$, define its degree-$k$ truncation by $\sum_{S\subseteq[n],\,|S|\le k}\widehat f(S)\,\chi_S(x)$, where $\widehat f(S)$ is the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $S$ and $\chi_S$ is the monomial indexed by $S$.
caveat: The supplied material does not define the Fourier coefficient or monomial notation used in the construction.
